p: ye the lamb to the ruler: That is, offer a sacrifice, by which he derides their long delay, who would not repent when the Lord called them, showing them that it is now too late seeing the vengeance of God is on them.
wandering bird cast out of the: There is no remedy but that you must flee.
make thy shadow as the night: He shows what Moab would have done, when Israel their neighbour was in affliction, to whom because they would give no shadow or comfort, they are now left comfortless.
is at an end: The Assyrians will oppress the Israelites but for a while.
and he shall sit upon it: Meaning, Christ.
lies shall not be so: Their vain confidence and proud bragging will deceive them, Jer 48:2.
stricken: For all your mourning, yet the city will be destroyed even to the foundation.
the lords of the nations have: That is, the Assyrians and other enemies.
Jazer: Meaning that the country of Moab was now destroyed, and all the precious things of it were carried into the borders yea into other countries and over the sea.
bewail with the weeping of Jazer: He shows that their plague was so great that it would have moved any man to lament with them, as in Ps 141:5.
harvest is fallen: The enemies are come upon you, and shout for joy when they carry your conveniences from you as in Jer 48:33.
heart shall sound like an harp: For sorrow and compassion.
sanctuary to pray: They will use all means to seek help for their idols, and all in vain: for Chemosh their great god will not be able to help them.
Within three years: He appointed a certain time to punish the enemies in.
hireling: Who will observe justly the time for which he is hired and serve no longer but will ever long for it.
